summary: Completed frontend testing for intelligence cards relocation from Journey page to School Detail page. All core features verified working: School Intelligence link button appears on Journey pages (Penn State and Stanford committed), clicking navigates correctly to /school/{domain}. Intelligence cards have been removed from Journey page. Journey page retains all existing elements (header, risk badges, checklist, timeline, at-a-glance, coaches panel). Note: School Intelligence section on School Detail page does NOT appear because demo user is on BASIC tier - this is expected behavior per code logic.

critical_code_review_comments: School Intelligence button correctly implemented with data-testid='view-school-intel-btn' in RecruitingJourney.js (lines 311-330)
Navigation uses program.domain to construct /school/{domain} URL correctly
Intelligence cards on School Detail page are gated by subscription tier (isBasic check) - requires Pro or Premium tier
All intelligence cards removed from Journey page - verified via data-testid queries returning 0 count
Code condition on line 433 of SchoolInfoPage.js: school.on_board && programId && !isBasic correctly prevents basic users from seeing intelligence section
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo account is on BASIC tier (subscription.tier='basic'). School Intelligence section on School Detail page requires Pro/Premium tier to be visible. To test the full intelligence cards section, would need a Pro/Premium tier test account. The Journey page correctly shows the School Intelligence link button for all schools regardless of tier. Penn State domain: psu.edu, Stanford domain: stanford.edu. Journey pages work correctly for both active schools and committed schools.
note_on_basic_tier_limitation: The School Intelligence section with Timeline, Roster, Scholarship, NIL, and School Insight cards only appears on School Detail pages for NON-BASIC tier users. Demo user is on basic tier so this section is correctly hidden. This is working as designed per the code logic.
